TOUHOUANCIENTS_SANAE.title: Faith Is for Whom?
TOUHOUANCIENTS_SANAE.description:
The Blight: from another world sounds an omen of ill tidings. The maiden, bearing her god's trust, sets her steps for lands afar.
The lofty Spire has known no sleep; the bounds of light and dark were blurred long since.
To a squalid nest she brings the hope of cleansing; upon a hollow glory she kindles the dawn of miracles.
Though the stars be rusted by the waters of the dark harbor, though the young shoots be buried in the soil of the deep wood.
Tears of home have brimmed the maiden's eyes, yet her unyielding faith has not been swayed a hair.

Sanae [sine]vividly[/sine] recounts the tale to the newcomer.

"So please, put your faith in [aqua]Moriya Shrine[/aqua] — thank you!!"
TOUHOUANCIENTS_SANAE.unlockInfo: Encounter the Ancient: [green]Sanae Kochiya[/green]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_SANAE.unlockText: You can encounter this wind priestess in Act 2 or Act 3.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_MAMIZOU.title: Futatsuiwa of Preon
TOUHOUANCIENTS_MAMIZOU.description:
Hearing the Sage's announcement, the leaders of Myouren Temple and the Divine Spirit Mausoleum are raring to go.
Isn't this the perfect chance to spread the faith?
But who should be sent to the Spire to secure the greatest profit? Buddhism and Taoism would not yield to each other here.

"Heh. Then let this neutral old hag go as the representative of both sides."
Mamizou had caught the scent of the opportunity at once. This tanuki boss never minds snatching a little profit for her subordinates. And of course, for that like-minded old friend of hers.

"Now then — let's raise some hell!"
TOUHOUANCIENTS_MAMIZOU.unlockInfo: Encounter the Ancient: [gold]Mamizou Futatsuiwa[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
TOUHOUANCIENTS_MAMIZOU.unlockText: You can encounter this ever-shifting boss of the bake-danuki in Act 2 or Act 3.
